# transfa

File sharing for AI agents and developers. Upload any file, get a signed URL. No account required.

## What it does

- Upload a file → get an agent link (direct download) + human link (browser share page)
- SHA-256 returned on every upload, verified on `tf download`
- Configurable TTL (1h to 30d), optional password gate, optional download limit
- Pipeline manifests: tag uploads with run_id, step, consumer, intent
- Grace period: file stays downloadable N hours after TTL for delayed pipeline steps

## MCP server (for AI assistants)

Install: add to claude_desktop_config.json or any MCP host

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "transfa": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "transfa-mcp"],
      "env": { "TRANSFA_API_KEY": "your-key" }
    }
  }
}
```

Tools: upload, file_info, list_uploads, delete_upload

## CLI

```
npm install -g transfa
tf upload ./report.pdf                      # returns signed URL, no account needed
tf upload ./model.pt --expires=24h --grace=12h
tf download a7f9k2                          # streams + verifies SHA-256 by default
tf watch a7f9k2                             # tail download events
tf run run-42                               # list all artifacts in a pipeline run
```

## REST API

Base URL: https://transfa.sh
Auth: Bearer token via Authorization header or X-Api-Key header
OpenAPI spec: https://transfa.sh/openapi.yaml

### Upload a file
POST /api/upload (multipart/form-data)
Fields: file (required), ttl, filename, max_downloads, password, grace, run_id, step, consumer, intent
Response: { id, download_url, url, filename, bytes, sha256, expires_at }

### Download a file
GET /api/download/:id
Headers: X-Transfa-SHA256 (hash), X-Transfa-Expires (ISO timestamp)
Query: password (if protected)

### File metadata
GET /api/download/info/:id
Response: { id, filename, bytes, sha256, expires_at, download_count, has_password, expired, in_grace, active }

### List uploads (auth required)
GET /api/upload?limit=20&offset=0

### Delete upload (auth required)
DELETE /api/upload/:id

### Extend TTL (auth required)
PATCH /api/upload/:id/extend
Body: { ttl: "7d" }

### Pipeline manifest
GET /api/run/:run_id
Response: { run_id, total, artifacts[] }

## GitHub Actions

```yaml
- uses: colapsis/transfa-action@v1
  id: upload
  with:
    file: ./dist/report.pdf
    api-key: ${{ secrets.TRANSFA_API_KEY }}
# outputs: agent-link, human-link, sha256, expires-at, id
```

## Security model

Links provide: content integrity (SHA-256), optional password gate, hard TTL.
Links do NOT provide: identity verification on the downloader (anyone with the URL can fetch).
Good for: internal pipelines, ephemeral artifacts, dev/staging handoffs.
Not for: regulated data requiring audited identity-based access control.

## Pricing

- Free: 500 MB/upload, 7d TTL, 20 uploads/day, no account required for guest uploads
- Pro ($12/mo): 50 GB/upload, 30d TTL, unlimited uploads, API + MCP
- Team ($48/mo): 100 GB/upload, custom TTL, 5 seats, audit log, SAML SSO
